definition_zh: 结合微分求积离散与有限元组织的数值方法。
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道及其与隧道、土体耦合系统的结构动力建模，通过位移基函数与微分求积权系数构造结构单元或轨道结构的动力矩阵，供耦合动力分析使用。

complete_examples.text: A substructure coordination method is proposed based on the vehicle–track–soil finite element method (FEM) and differential quadrature finite element method (DQFEM) coupled dynamic model.

In this paper, substructure coordination methods for large-scale soil structure based on penalty method, Lagrange method and elimination method are proposed and applied in the vehicle–track–soil finite element method–differential quadrature finite element method (FEM–DQFEM) dynamic interaction model.
